results.name: GET /api/ops/relay without the service token: refused (401)
GET /api/ops/relay/metrics without the service token: refused (401)
with the service token: a snapshot with health, counters, pending revocations and the invariant audit
Prometheus metrics expose the alerting signals
fixture: a meeting, a host, three admitted guests, one allowed to present
the allowed guest starts a share
a viewer that FORGES role/participant fields in the request still gets a VIEWER credential
a guest WITHOUT permission cannot start a share (403)
a viewer cannot revoke the share (403)
a viewer cannot stop someone else's share (403/404)
a viewer cannot hand the floor over (403)
a share id that is not a UUID is refused (400), not passed to the database
a token of ANOTHER meeting cannot obtain credentials for this share (403)
an oversized request body is refused (4xx, never a 5xx)
credential flooding is bounded: 429 after 6 live credentials, and the registry agrees
the share flows before the revoke
host revokes: the API answers revoked
no media is delivered after the revoke
the revoked presenter's heartbeat is refused (409/404)
the revoked presenter cannot get new credentials for that share (409)
the old presenter credential and the old viewer credential are both refused by coturn (401)
the registry shows every credential of the share revoked AND terminated
AUDIT: issued and terminated credentials are recorded per meeting (relay.credential_issued / relay.credential_terminated)
a NEW share needs a NEW authorization and works (policy: the host revoking a SHARE does not silently remove the person; withdraw their permission to stop them presenting)
host WITHDRAWS the permission: the live share ends at once (server decision, no client cooperation)
and the guest cannot start another (403)
six simultaneous start requests from three people leave EXACTLY ONE active share (database invariant)
two meetings share at the same time through the same relay
revoking meeting 1's share stops meeting 1 and does NOT touch meeting 2
host hands the floor to someone else: the previous presenter's media stops and the new person may start
a live credential of a share that ended behind the hooks' back is revoked and terminated by the sweeper
a participant who is no longer admitted loses every relay credential within one sweep
after the repairs the invariant audit is clean and no revocation is pending
(TTL 30 s) the share flows
while the presenter heartbeats, credentials are renewed and the share outlives the TTL basis
Meet is killed: media CONTINUES (the relay does not depend on Meet at this instant)
the stand-alone REAPER (Meet still down) ends the media of the expired credential
no allocation of either credential remains in coturn
Meet restarts: the share whose presenter vanished is ended by its lease (no zombie share)
and every credential row of it is terminated by the boot reconcile
database down: Meet answers an error, does not crash, grants nothing
with the database down and heartbeats failing, the credentials expire and the REAPER ends the media (bound = TTL + sweep)
database back: Meet recovers on its own and ends the share whose lease lapsed
Meet is still serving after the outage (no restart needed)
WITHOUT a live Shield-authorized session a presenter cannot start a share (403): the Shield decides nothing about a person it cannot see
the Shield-authorized sessions connect
with a live session the share starts
a viewer with a live session gets credentials
presenter -> viewer 1 flows through the relay
presenter -> viewer 2 flows through the relay
the Shield SUSPENDS viewer 1: his screen media stops, his socket is closed with a reason, his credentials are terminated
and everybody else keeps seeing the share (presenter and viewer 2 untouched)
the denied person cannot come back with the same token (403 on the API)
the Shield SUSPENDS the presenter: the share ends in Meet and ALL viewers' media stops (one authoritative state)
every relay credential of the share is revoked and terminated
(Shield healthy again) a presenter with a live session starts a share
it flows
the SHIELD GOES DOWN: after the grace period the sessions are closed, the lease is cut, the share ends and the relay media STOPS (fail closed, bounded)
